notes.title: Version 2.0.3
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting News, Players! 🎉
Greetings to all our amazing players! We hope you've been having a fantastic year filled with good health and happiness.

We're thrilled to announce the release of this year's version of our beloved game! 🌟 Brace yourselves for a great update, packed with an array of new features that will take your gaming experience to new heights:

✨ Introducing NPCs: Get ready to interact with fascinating non-playable characters that will add depth and excitement to your gameplay.

🎵 Dive into the Groove: We've added an incredible lineup of catchy songs that will keep you dancing all night long! Get ready to feel the rhythm and show off your moves.

🎆 Mesmerizing Effects: Prepare to be dazzled by stunning visual effects that will transport you to a world of magic and wonder. Your gameplay has never looked this spectacular!

🔥 Soar with Wings: Unlock the power of flight and showcase your style with a stunning selection of wings. Take your avatar to new heights and stand out from the crowd!

🌟 Expanded Character Roster: Choose from an expanded range of characters, each with their own unique outfit. Find your perfect match and conquer the dance floor!

🐾 Lovable Pets: Say hello to adorable companions! Unlock and nurture cute pets that will join you in your dancing move. They're the perfect partners to share your joy with!

💃 Dance Modes Galore: We've heard your requests and are thrilled to introduce two new dance modes: B-BOY and CRAZY. Get ready to bust out epic moves and set the stage on fire!

We can't wait for you to dive into this exciting new update. Your enjoyment and well-being are always our top priorities, so remember to take care of yourselves and stay healthy!
Keep grooving and spreading the joy of dance!

Cheers,
Dancing Angel Admin

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hi Players,

Sorry for the long delay, I would like to introduce a new mode: Battle Mode. I will answer some questions:

[b]1) Why a Rhythm game has Battle mode?[/b]
Basically, I want to offer the player another option to enjoy my game. You can use your character, your Gold, and Ruby for both modes. That's why instead of creating a separate game for Battle mode, I include it as another option in this game. If you don't like Battle mode, just ignore it and enjoy Dance mode. 

[b]2) Will I develop Battle mode and Dance mode at the same time?[/b]
Yes. Introducing Battle mode doesn't mean that I stop Dance mode development. My main priority is Dance mode always.

[b]3) what is my future plan?[/b]
[list]
[*] Mobile app for this game (Android) and hopefully will release by Christmas.
[*] New Scene for Christmas Event.
[*] Add Christmas songs.
[/list]

Battle mode guide: [url=http://dancingangels.tk/news;action=detail;type=GUIDE;id=5f94e0e83ff18c5d2ba82655]here[/url]

Again, thanks for your support and hope you all enjoy my game.

Thanks,
Dancing Angel Admin

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Released
notes.notes:
Hi Dancers,

I would glad to introduce a new item category: "CHARACTER".  There are 2 ways to obtain it.
1) BUY: You can buy them in SHOP under the "CHARACTER" tab. 
2) DEFEAT: You need to defeat them in the BOSS room and try your luck in a lucky draw to obtain them. [b](not ready in this version)[/b]

===== CHARACTER ITEM vs DEFAULT CHARACTER =====
Basically, Character has a different appearance to default character. However, these Characters can not swap clothes whereas default Characters can do that.

=======FUTURE PLAN FOR  CHARACTER ITEM ========
Only this release, these Characters have not been available yet in the BOSS room. These things will be released in the next releases. So, be ready to participate in the BOSS room and obtain these Character by defeating them in BOSS room.

Thanks,
Dancing Angel Admin
